notes.title: Time Detective Kim - Important Notice
notes.content:
Hello, Time Detectives.
Some players have inquired about the game's ending point, and we would like to provide clear guidance on this matter.
The point where the current story concludes is the end of the game. We apologize for any confusion caused by the absence of dedicated ending sequences or completion messages.
We sincerely thank everyone who has played our game and provided valuable feedback.
Development Team
